title: Survivor Souls — Ember Boons
status: Proposed skill design; numeric values need playtesting.

skills.name: Sharpened Bolts
skills.description: Increase the damage of your main weapon bolts.
skills.why_it_works: A dependable damage choice that supports every projectile build.
upgrade_direction: Finish with a larger damage bonus.
skills.balance_notes: Use additive weapon-damage bonuses. Do not give every secondary effect its own copy of this bonus.

skills.name: Quick Draw
skills.description: Increase main weapon attack speed.
skills.why_it_works: The change is immediate: shorter waits and a smoother firing rhythm.
skills.balance_notes: Clamp the minimum firing interval and preserve readable attack animations.

skills.name: Vigor
skills.description: Increase maximum health and restore health equal to the amount gained.
skills.why_it_works: A simple survival choice that feels useful as soon as it is selected.
upgrade_direction: Gain maximum health and an equal heal.
skills.balance_notes: Heal only the increase from the previous rank, not the full cumulative bonus.

skills.name: Fleet Foot
skills.description: Increase movement speed for repositioning and kiting.
skills.why_it_works: Survival can come from better movement as well as more damage.
skills.balance_notes: Set a movement-speed ceiling that preserves touch-control precision.

skills.name: Keen Eye
skills.description: Increase critical-hit chance and critical damage.
skills.why_it_works: Bright critical impacts make a focused damage build satisfying.
skills.balance_notes: Cap critical chance. Critical bonuses should not create recursive proc rolls.

skills.name: Piercing Bolts
skills.description: Bolts pass through additional enemies, losing damage after each penetration.
skills.why_it_works: Lining up a horde becomes a deliberate and rewarding choice.
upgrade_direction: Reduce falloff and reach the final pierce count.
skills.balance_notes: Pierce and Ricochet share a finite hit budget. Ricochet takes priority when a valid new target is nearby.

skills.name: Ember Bolts
skills.description: Weapon hits ignite enemies for damage over time.
skills.why_it_works: Give fire one clear identity. Soul Burst owns death explosions; frost owns freezing.
skills.balance_notes: Remove the existing slow, stun, spread, and death blast. Repeated hits refresh one burn instead of stacking without limit.

skills.name: Frost Bolts
skills.description: Every few direct weapon hits freeze the struck enemy briefly.
skills.why_it_works: A crisp freeze and shatter visual gives crowd control a readable identity.
upgrade_direction: Improve freeze duration against normal enemies.
skills.balance_notes: Bosses receive a short slow rather than a full freeze. Add a per-target freeze cooldown.

skills.name: Venom Bolts
skills.description: Poison enemies with a longer damage-over-time effect than Ember Bolts.
skills.why_it_works: A slower attrition option for tagging several threats while kiting.
upgrade_direction: Raise the poison stack cap to a small fixed number.
skills.balance_notes: Use capped stacks and refresh rules. Poison does not spread automatically or trigger another poison hit.

skills.name: Storm Touch
skills.description: Weapon hits release a short electrical arc to one nearby enemy.
skills.why_it_works: Small, frequent arcs make lightning distinct from a physical ricochet chain.
skills.balance_notes: Arcs cannot create more arcs or count as weapon hits for Legendary triggers.

skills.name: Ashen Heart
skills.description: Improve healing from health pickups and slightly increase their drop chance.
skills.why_it_works: A measured sustain option that preserves the need to dodge.
upgrade_direction: Add a modest health-pickup drop bonus.
skills.balance_notes: Only health pickups benefit. Do not multiply revive healing or Last Oath lifesteal.

skills.name: Repelling Bolts
skills.description: Every few main weapon hits knock a normal enemy back.
skills.why_it_works: A tangible defensive reward for firing into an approaching horde.
skills.balance_notes: Bosses and immovable enemies ignore displacement. Apply a per-target knockback cooldown.

skills.name: Stormshock
skills.tagline: A little thunder. A moment to breathe.
skills.description: Every fourth direct weapon hit releases yellow chain lightning into the struck zombie and up to two nearby zombies: three targets total. Each takes 60% weapon damage and a 0.25-second mini-stun. Lightning jumps only to another zombie within 3 metres of the previous target.
skills.why_it_works: A bright, crackling chain catches a small cluster, interrupts their approach, and buys a brief escape window. It feels more forceful than Storm Touch’s small damage-only arcs without shocking the entire horde.
upgrade_direction: Strike up to 3 zombies for 60% weapon damage each; mini-stun each for 0.25 seconds.
Strike up to 4 zombies for 70% weapon damage each; keep the same short stun.
Strike up to 5 zombies for 80% weapon damage each; keep the same jump range and stun.
skills.balance_notes: Proposed starting values for playtesting. Minimum 2-second cooldown between chains. Never revisit a zombie in one chain; stop if no unhit target is within 3 metres. Mini-stuns do not stack, and a target cannot be stunned again for 1 second. Bosses take damage and a brief reduced slow instead of a stun. Chain hits cannot trigger Storm Touch, Ricochet, another Stormshock, or weapon-hit counters. VFX: thin jagged yellow arcs connect targets, each zombie gains a brief yellow electrical outline with small sparks and a quick twitch, then returns to normal. No full-screen flash.
skills.current_game_comparison: New Survivor Souls concept requested for this catalog
skills.reference: Original: bounded yellow chain lightning with a mini-stun

skills.name: Front Arrow +1
skills.description: Add a parallel forward bolt to each volley, with a per-bolt damage trade-off.
skills.why_it_works: Both bolts can connect with a large target, creating a satisfying boss-focused pickup.
upgrade_direction: Improve forward-bolt damage without adding more lanes.
skills.balance_notes: Use one extra forward lane. Keep the two projectiles spatially distinct and tune combined damage with Multishot.

skills.name: Spread Shot
skills.tagline: Turn a lane into a fan
skills.description: Fire two extra angled bolts alongside the central shot.
skills.why_it_works: Wider coverage produces an obvious visual transformation and catches flanking enemies.
upgrade_direction: Widen coverage or add a capped second pair.
skills.balance_notes: Keep this separate from Multishot. The existing internal multishot stat currently means spread bolts.

skills.name: Bouncy Wall
skills.tagline: Let the room fight for you
skills.description: Bolts rebound off solid arena walls with reduced damage.
skills.why_it_works: Angled shots return to the fight and make arena geometry part of the build.
skills.balance_notes: Only offer in arenas with usable walls. Use a maximum lifetime and bounce count for every projectile.

skills.name: Rear Arrow +1
skills.tagline: Nothing at your back is safe
skills.description: Fire one additional bolt behind the hero with each volley.
skills.why_it_works: Enemies following the hero become targets while the forward attack stays focused.
upgrade_direction: Improve its damage after a wall rebound.
skills.balance_notes: Keep rear damage below an additional full forward volley. Aim relative to the weapon firing direction.

skills.name: Soul Burst
skills.description: Defeated enemies release an explosion that damages nearby enemies.
skills.why_it_works: Explosive pack clearing has a strong payoff without occupying a Legendary slot.
skills.balance_notes: Burst kills can damage other enemies but cannot generate another Soul Burst. This prevents uncontrolled recursion.

skills.name: Hallowed Shield
skills.description: Periodically gain a short window of damage immunity.
skills.why_it_works: A visible ward creates occasional breathing room for a survival build.
skills.balance_notes: Use a visible countdown and activation effect. Overlapping immunity windows do not stack their durations.
skills.current_game_comparison: Hallowed Shield · Epic; returned from deferred list

skills.name: Holy Tomes
skills.description: Holy tomes orbit the hero and damage enemies they touch.
skills.why_it_works: A readable, constant close-range damage layer already present in Survivor Souls.
upgrade_direction: Summon a pair of orbiting tomes.
Increase orbit coverage and tome count.
Add a small impact flash on contact.
skills.balance_notes: Tomes deal contact damage only; they do not block incoming projectiles. Use a per-enemy contact interval.

skills.name: Ember Wheel
skills.description: Two firebrands orbit the hero, burning enemies on contact.
skills.why_it_works: An aggressive inner orbit that rewards weaving near a horde.
skills.balance_notes: Shares one burn per target with Ember Bolts; use the stronger burn and refresh its duration.

skills.name: Rime Blades
skills.description: Ice blades orbit the hero and briefly slow enemies on contact.
skills.why_it_works: A defensive orbit helps the hero escape enemies that enter close range.
skills.balance_notes: Contact slows do not stack. Bosses receive a reduced slow and cannot be permanently controlled.

skills.name: Storm Satellites
skills.description: Charged orbs circle at medium range and periodically zap the nearest enemy.
skills.why_it_works: Orbiters that deal ranged damage feel different from contact-only rings.
upgrade_direction: Allow each discharge one short secondary arc.
skills.balance_notes: Satellite arcs are secondary damage and cannot trigger Storm Touch or Legendary weapon-hit counters.
skills.reference: Original; inspired by Archero’s Bolt Circle

skills.name: Reaper Scythes
skills.description: A slow pair of spectral scythes sweeps a wide outer orbit, dealing heavy contact damage.
skills.why_it_works: A slower, heavier orbit creates strong visual contrast with books and sparks.
skills.balance_notes: Scythes are heavy sweeping attacks, not execute effects. Tune contact intervals to prevent repeated hits in one pass.

skills.name: Sentinel Halo
skills.tagline: Keep a little sky between you
skills.description: Two shield fragments orbit the hero and intercept enemy projectiles.
skills.why_it_works: A defensive orbit gives the family a role beyond stacking damage.
skills.balance_notes: Fragments block projectiles only, not contact damage, ground hazards, or boss beams. They do not deal contact damage.

skills.name: Multishot
skills.description: Repeat the weapon’s firing pattern in a second volley shortly after the first.
skills.why_it_works: A run-defining pickup that makes forward, spread, and rear shots all feel more powerful.
upgrade_direction: Repeat the complete firing pattern once.
Reduce the repeated volley’s damage penalty.
Improve repeated-volley damage; keep volley count capped.
skills.balance_notes: Confirm the current Double Shot timing. Use damage and interval penalties to avoid multiplying every lane at full damage.

skills.name: Ricochet
skills.description: Bolts jump between nearby enemies, losing some damage with each hop.
skills.why_it_works: The first pickup should visibly stitch a chain through the horde.
skills.balance_notes: Never revisit a target in the same projectile chain. Share a finite hit budget with Pierce and stop when no valid target is nearby.

skills.name: Second Dawn
skills.description: Once per run, a fatal hit instead revives the hero with partial health, clears nearby threats with a shockwave, and grants brief immunity.
skills.why_it_works: The requested revive becomes an unmistakable comeback moment.
skills.balance_notes: One revive per run across all ranks. Upgrading cannot reset a consumed charge. The shockwave cannot trigger on-kill skill chains.

skills.name: Eclipse Crown
skills.tagline: Wear the end of the sun
skills.description: Periodically align all owned orbiters into a sweeping eclipse formation, then release a dark pulse and restore their normal orbits.
skills.why_it_works: A spectacular payoff for collecting different circling skills.
upgrade_direction: Unlock the eclipse formation and pulse.
skills.balance_notes: Requires at least one orbital skill. Preserve each orbiter’s role; shield fragments still block rather than deal damage. Cap pulse scaling per owned orbital skill.

skills.name: Grave Choir
skills.description: Weapon kills have a chance to raise a temporary spectral archer that fires at enemies.
skills.why_it_works: The battlefield visibly changes as an army of echoes joins the hero.
upgrade_direction: Raise temporary archers, with a small summon cap.
skills.balance_notes: Summon kills cannot summon more archers or trigger weapon-hit counters. Cap active archers and use simple target selection.

skills.name: Last Oath
skills.tagline: The closer the grave, the brighter the vow
skills.description: Dropping below a low-health threshold triggers a short surge of weapon damage and limited lifesteal.
skills.why_it_works: A dramatic risk-and-reward comeback option for players who keep fighting under pressure.
skills.balance_notes: Use a long cooldown, cap healing per activation, and require health to recover above the threshold before rearming. No invulnerability.
skills.reference: Original; combines a low-health trigger with a bounded covenant

skills.name: Stolen Moment
skills.description: After enough main-weapon volleys, a stationary time echo repeats the last firing pattern several times while the hero can reposition.
skills.why_it_works: A burst of spectral volleys creates a mobile escape window in a stand-to-shoot game.
upgrade_direction: Create a brief time echo after a volley threshold.
skills.balance_notes: Count original volleys only. Echoes cannot create echoes, inherit Multishot repetition, or trigger other weapon-hit counters.

skills.name: Sovereign’s Fall
skills.description: After enough direct weapon critical hits, a colossal spectral sword strikes the current target and damages enemies around it.
skills.why_it_works: An enormous, readable impact turns a critical build into an event.
skills.balance_notes: Count direct weapon critical hits only and enforce a minimum trigger interval. This is damage, not an instant kill; bosses remain valid targets.
